short_description: Route three coloured trains through eight switchyards and beat your fewest-flips record.
description: Route three coloured trains through eight switchyards and beat your fewest-flips record. Match the three incoming trains to the colours at the right edge. The back labels them A/B/C. Turn to select a pair of points, click to switch straight/crossed, and press Start to dispatch. Hold Start to reset the yard. Click after a win to advance. Personal bests and the current yard survive restart.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
